_comment: Every player-visible string in the 1.21.11 build. Java holds keys and arguments only; these values are read at startup and sent to clients as finished text. A vanilla client has no lang file for this mod, so a translatable component - the window title included - would arrive as a raw key; the server resolves the key here and sends the words.
